@dogecoin_empire There is subtle, engaging, whew, and "What the hell are you covering up?" 

Careful which you choose.

@dogecoin_empire Monogamy is the natural state. One woman at a time. Multiple women at a time has always been the secondary thought, not the primary driving natural order. It is a learned idea. Now, the length in between women is questionable; it could be minutes, it could be years.
